snippet.title: Viscerafest - Console Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Viscerafest, the sci-fi fantasy arena FPS, is gunning for even more victims and will arrive to Playstation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on April 9, 2026 - with the Nintendo Switch version coming later on!

Wishlist now!
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10013104/
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/viscerafest/9P1LX8KMTSX4

Get the game on PC:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1406780/Viscerafest/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/viscerafest
EGS: https://www.epicgames.com/store/p/viscerafest

Viscerafest is a Sci-Fi Fantasy Singleplayer Arena FPS with minor Collectathon elements. Fight through hordes of aliens and eldritch monstrosities wielding a slew of powerful weapons, juggling your resources, and exploring over 26 intricately designed hand crafted levels.

Follow Fulqrum Publishing on:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/FulqrumPublishing
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/FulqrumPublishing
Website: http://www.FulqrumPublishing.com/
